output.headline: Francisco Partners: an open-platform technology sponsor with a Health IT precedent and a 25.3% IRR at the asking price.
output.differentiator: Among the sponsors with an open platform, Francisco Partners has closed a higher share of its deals than TPG Capital and Warburg Pincus, and its median multiple paid is above both.
output.why_them: Add-on to an open platform; 25.3% IRR at the ask

acquirer_overview.title: Francisco Partners: a technology-focused sponsor with 14 control deals since 2017
points: 14 deals from 2017 to 2023, all control deals; 12 closed (86%) [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Describes itself as "one of the largest and most active technology-focused private equity firms in the world"; more than $75 billion raised, undated [P:1, P:2].
Only 1 deal in Health IT and 13 outside it; Physician Groups and Medical Devices lead with 3 deals each [T:record, K:by_sub_sector].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Francisco Partners can add the target to an open platform, backed by growth and margin motives
points: Growth drove 6 of 14 deals and margin improvement 5 of 14, matching the target's 20.0% growth and 25.0% margin [M:high_growth, M:margin_improvement].
Its sponsor angles are an add-on to an open platform in the sub-sector and size fit; 6 of 14 deals sit in the $150M-$600M band [A:angles, K:size_band].
Slight factors for: prior purchases from this kind of seller, deal size and activity; against: its low share of sub-sector deals [S:own_fit_s, S:not_smaller, S:activity, S:sector_share].

precedent_activity.title: One Health IT precedent, plus larger deals at 15.3x to 24.8x
points: Hudson Care Analytics, same sub-sector: $16M Management Buyout, 2020, 18.9x, closed [D:MA-2020-0260].
Prime Medical Technologies ($446M Leveraged Buyout, 2021, 15.3x) and Pacific Biopharma ($724M Merger of Equals, 2021, 23.6x) both closed [D:MA-2021-0297, D:MA-2021-0465].
Coastal Gene Therapy: $9,980M Platform Investment, 2023, 24.8x, closed. Taft Device Solutions ($153M, 2022, 21.1x) is only rumored [D:MA-2023-0236, D:MA-2022-0398].

valuation_context.title: The median is the defensible anchor, and returns clear at the ask
points: 13 comparable deals, all in the sub-sector: 19.4x at the 25th percentile, 21.4x median, 23.3x at the 75th [V:comps].
The target's 25.0% margin is above the comps' 22.2% median but not in their top quarter, so the 50th percentile is defensible [V:comps].
Francisco Partners' median paid is 16.2x; at 5.0x leverage, IRR at the ask is 25.3% against a 20% target, with maximum price $356M [T:record, V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Thin Health IT record
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 of 14 deals is in Health IT, and none are in the National region [T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Its open platform in the sub-sector gives an add-on route [A:angles].
risk_flags.reality: Fit rests on the platform, not repeated sub-sector deals; sub-sector share counts against it [S:sector_share].

risk_flags.title: Price behaviour below the comps
risk_flags.concern: Its median paid of 16.2x is well below the 21.4x comp median [T:record, V:comps].
risk_flags.mitigant: IRR at the ask is 25.3% against a 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: Returns leave room to reach the median; maximum price is $356M [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Equity capacity unconfirmed
risk_flags.concern: Fund size was not researched, so equity capacity is unconfirmed [R:FUND_SIZE_UNKNOWN].
risk_flags.mitigant: More than $75 billion raised, undated, against an equity cheque of $239M [P:2, V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: Capital raised is a good sign, but fund capacity needs checking before the call [R:FUND_SIZE_UNKNOWN].

conviction.rationale: Neutral on sub-sector depth, with only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector for Francisco Partners; supported by an open platform in the sub-sector, which gives an add-on route [C:conviction, A:angles].
